subject: Maths
topic_line: Help JJ & Mikey find the treasure!
intro_voice: Hi friends! I'm JJ, and this is Mikey! Welcome to Graph Garden. Answer five questions, collect five gems, and we find the treasure! Ready? Let's go!
outro_voice: Woohoo! All five gems! You found the treasure! You're a maths superstar. See you next time!

questions.q: In a chart: 8 apples, 6 bananas, 2 mangoes. How many fruits in all?
questions.voice_q: Add the chart: 8, 6 and 2. How many in all?

questions.q: In a chart: 9 apples, 6 bananas, 6 mangoes. How many fruits in all?
questions.voice_q: Add the chart: 9, 6 and 6. How many in all?

questions.q: In a chart: 2 apples, 6 bananas, 9 mangoes. How many fruits in all?
questions.voice_q: Add the chart: 2, 6 and 9. How many in all?

questions.q: In a chart: 7 apples, 6 bananas, 4 mangoes. How many fruits in all?
questions.voice_q: Add the chart: 7, 6 and 4. How many in all?

questions.q: In a chart: 5 apples, 2 bananas, 5 mangoes. How many fruits in all?
